Hi Lara / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation this morning. Quick recap of the key pain points and goals we heard, and a proposed mutual action plan to keep momentum:

Pain points you described
- Large latency spikes during morning batch processing windows (observed 95th/99th spikes impacting user-facing features).
- Rising inference cost as usage scales and varied traffic patterns (hard to predict monthly spend).
- Compliance requirement: PH wants data residency + strict audit logs for model inputs; on-prem or VPC option is preferred for pilot.

Goals you shared
1) Reduce per-token cost by ~30–40% for the search/triage flow without materially degrading answer quality.
2) 99th percentile tail latency under 200ms for short prompt paths (under 256 tokens) during peak.
3) Pilot under Pioneer-managed VPC with audit logging and KMS integration; procurement and security sign-off in Q3.

Proposed Mutual Action Plan (high level)
- Milestone A (Discovery -> Scope): finalize pilot scope & success metrics (owners: Pioneer product + Redwood AE). Target: 2027-07-07
- Milestone B (Security & Procurement): complete security questionnaire and legal/DPA draft (owners: Pioneer security, Redwood compliance). Target: 2027-07-21
- Milestone C (Pilot Run): deploy dedicated pilot (VPC) and run 2-week load/quality evaluation (owners: Pioneer infra, Redwood SRE). Target start: 2027-08-08
- Milestone D (Decision & Commit): evaluate results and decide on expanded deployment or Dedicated capacity commit (owners: Pioneer exec sponsor + Redwood sales). Target: 2027-08-30

We will:
- Send an initial MPA spreadsheet with responsibilities and dates (attached).
- Share the Redwood security brief and SOC2 evidence matrix for your security team (attached).
- Block time for a short technical walkthrough with Karthik to confirm deployment architecture and latency profile tradeoffs.

Next steps / asks for Pioneer
1) Confirm owners for procurement and infra (we have Tom and Lara listed — please confirm).
2) Identify an exec sponsor for decisioning (name + role).
3) Please share estimated monthly call volume for the triage flow so we can size Dedicated / pilot setup more accurately.

I'll follow up with the MPA attached and a calendar invite for a short architecture call next week.
